user_authorization: Research direct weight changes, run an experiment, measure actual change and parallelize based on results.
allowed: CPU algebraic edits of checkpoint copies, local inference and semantic evaluation; parallel CPU research/analysis/review; serialized GPU
not_allowed: changing old STOP or final selection
UI promotion without measured fresh holdout improvement
refinement_gate: At least two additional complete development conversations over baseline, no reduction in complete tool conversations or mechanical no-call success. Otherwise stop after first wave.
holdout_policy: Independently authored fresh 40-case suite sealed before candidate results; only selected candidate and unchanged baseline evaluated once; selection frozen first; no tuning afterwards.
